name: doable-code-context
description: Connect private code to Doable through MCP: resolve grounded context requests and serve Doable code agent requests from a machine.

interface.shortDescription: Answer Doable's requests from private code
interface.longDescription: Connect the current private workspace through the configured Doable MCP connection and answer frozen context requests with grounded findings; or, on a machine that holds the product's repositories, serve the requests a Doable chat sends in plain words (questions about the code and about what the machine can do, test data to make, backend state to read and failed runs to debug). Context answers keep exact source locations local; code agent results may hold file paths, line numbers and what the code does in words, never code, never secrets.
defaultPrompt: Resolve Doable context request DQ-7F3K for organization HireEZ (hireez).
Serve Doable code agent requests on this machine.
Connect this workspace to Doable for code-context requests.
